sloka: अद्य ते कतिचित् रात्र्यः च्युतस्य आर्यक वेश्मनः ।अपि न अध्व श्रमः शीघ्रम् रथेन आपततः तव ॥२-७२-५॥
transliteration: adya te katicit rātryaḥ cyutasya āryaka veśmanaḥ ।api na adhva śramaḥ śīghram rathena āpatataḥ tava ॥2-72-5॥

translations.english: How many nights have you spent (on the way) since you left your noble grandfather's residence? Hasn't the hurried journey (over such a long distance) on the chariot left you exhausted?
